name: inputs/otp-input
title: OTP input
description: One-time codes, drawn as cells, typed as one field.

files.content:
export { OtpInput, sanitizeCode } from './OtpInput';
export type { OtpInputProps } from './OtpInput';

keyboard.action: Type the next character; invalid characters are ignored.
Move focus into and out of the field.

notes: A single native `<input>` with a `<label>`, `autocomplete="one-time-code"` and the right `inputmode`, so it is announced as one text field with its whole value.
The cells are decorative (`aria-hidden`); the input itself carries the value, hint and error.
The hint and error are linked with `aria-describedby`; an error sets `aria-invalid` and turns every cell red with a thicker edge.
Cells are 48 × 56 px (40 × 48 px on narrow screens).
accessibility.reducedMotion: The caret in the next empty cell does not blink.
